card.name: Spaces before numbers in definitions
card.fires_on: Mixed spots in explanatory or technical text, often a space just before a number or a closing quote or possessive after a term being defined. No single word type dominates.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A bare space token right before a number in a worked example or location.
modes.example: 1 patient-year is equal to 2 patients each treated for<< >>6 months

modes.label: Quote or possessive after a term
modes.description: A closing quote or 's right after a defined term or noun in explanatory text.
modes.example: "Thermo" means heat and "meter<<">> means to measure.

modes.label: Linking word in technical text
modes.description: A preposition or letter partway through a technical phrase.
